title: Light on
meta_description: You can make some automation with ROBOPARTS.
full_description: LightOn is the name of this app.This app simply turns the light on.and then it can start other app next.LightOnis one of the bALLS apps of iL-ROBOPARTS collection.iL-ROBOPARTS is a collection of Apps such as sENSORS, Kicker, bALLS.You can build up every kind of systems by combination of them.e.x.ifShook(sENSORS) -> Kicker -> GMailTex(bALLS)This system send a text gmail when a shock happened.ifLigetened(sENSORS) -> Kicker -> PlaySome(bALLS)This system starts to play some movies when lit up the room light.In these days, some old, unused smart phone are available around.You can build up a system using with it.
